trust_center.repositoryDescription: The Zendesk Trust Center provides organizations everything they need to complete their security reviews. Browse documents, certifications, and compliance details with confidence. The Trust Center is updated regularly to reflect the latest audit results and subprocessor disclosures.

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: A public-facing document for agencies and organizations to enable the recommended security configurations for the Zendesk Platform to meet FedRAMP requirements.

certified_services.serviceDescription:
All product features below are categorized as Class C (Moderate).

- Ticketing
- Knowledge
- Messaging & Live Chat
- Analytics & Reporting
- Voice
- AI & Automation
- AI Agents
- Quality Assurance
- Advanced Data Privacy & Protection
- Workforce Management

certified.useCase: Provides the cloud infrastructure platform and services supporting the Zendesk for Government trust boundary. Zendesk inherits IaaS/PaaS controls from AWS according to its Customer Responsibility Matrix.
Provides data warehousing and supports Analytics functionality of the Zendesk platform. Also serves as the SIEM for the trust boundary.
Provides centralized identity and access management for Zendesk employees with access to the trust boundary.
Provides generative artifician intelligence and natural language processing services for the Zendesk platform.
Provides overarching cloud security posture management and vulnerability management capabilities.

nonCertified.useCase: Managed NoSQL document database service supporting application data for the offering, deployed in AWS US East / West.

nonCertified.name: Datadog
nonCertified.useCase: Logging and monitoring platform for production services.

nonCertified.useCase: Error reporting platform for production services.

nonCertified.name: Cloudflare
nonCertified.useCase: Zendesk's edge proxy layer. Performs DNS, TLS termination, WAF, and rate limiting for customer traffic.

current.service_desc: Zendesk for Government is an AI service platform that helps agencies deliver responsive, secure service at scale, for the people they serve and the employees who support them. With customer service, employee service and AI agents on one platform, agencies can resolve requests faster, automate routine work, and scale securely across departments.
